tools.name: list_services
tools.description: FREE. Catalog of this seller's pay-per-call x402 data endpoints with prices (USDC on Base) and how to pay. NOTE: the /u/* micro-utilities are free over MCP and paid per-request over HTTP.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: FREE. Liveness handshake: returns service name, version and server time.

tools.name: u_sha256
tools.description: FREE (no payment). SHA-256 hash/digest of a text string — also sha512 and sha3-256; returns hex. Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/sha256 over HTTP.

tools.name: u_uuid
tools.description: FREE (no payment). Generate a random UUID (uuid v4, RFC 9562) — 1..100 per call; format uuid|urn|hex|int. Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/uuid over HTTP.

tools.name: u_base64
tools.description: FREE (no payment). Base64 encode or decode a string — base64 encoder/decoder (body {mode:encode|decode,input}). Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/base64 over HTTP.

tools.name: u_base58
tools.description: FREE (no payment). Base58 encode or decode bytes/hex (Solana-style base58). Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/base58 over HTTP.

tools.name: u_hex
tools.description: FREE (no payment). Hex encode or decode text — hex string encoder/decoder. Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/hex over HTTP.

tools.name: u_urlcode
tools.description: FREE (no payment). URL encode or decode a string (percent-encoding) for query, path or fragment. Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/urlcode over HTTP.

tools.name: u_date_diff
tools.description: FREE (no payment). Difference between two ISO-8601 timestamps in days/seconds (date diff). Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/date-diff over HTTP.

tools.name: u_json
tools.description: FREE (no payment). Validate, pretty-print (0-8 spaces), or minify JSON — json formatter/validator. Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/json over HTTP.

tools.name: u_jwt
tools.description: FREE (no payment). Decode a JWT — parse header and payload claims without a key (no signature verification). Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/jwt over HTTP.

tools.name: u_address_check
tools.description: FREE (no payment). EVM address checksum and validation — check an Ethereum/Base address format before sending funds. Deterministic micro-utility; use over MCP or POST /u/address-check over HTTP.

tools.name: validate
tools.description: FREE (no payment). Decide accepted/rejected for a delivered brick.blue task result against the task's published acceptance rules. Returns {decision, accepted, verdict, reason}.

tools.name: rail_status
tools.description: PAID $0.020000 USDC via x402. Call before routing or accepting an x402 payment: multi-rail health (facilitators, settlement, market) across x402 rails (JSON).

tools.name: x402_integrity
tools.description: PAID $0.009000 USDC via x402. Call before trusting or paying a third-party x402 seller: catalog-vs-live integrity -- verify an x402 listing (payee, price, network, service, tags, bazaar block) against the live 402; an endpoint preflight for x402 catalog vs live offers, seller trust and listing consi

tools.name: token_snapshot
tools.description: PAID $0.020000 USDC via x402. Call before trading or pricing a Solana token: normalized live onchain snapshot (price, 24h change, liquidity, 24h volume, top DEX pair).

tools.name: price_quote
tools.description: PAID $0.005000 USDC via x402. Call before pricing or settling a crypto payment: live spot prices for one or more coins by CoinGecko id (USD price, 24h change, market cap) from a keyless multi-source chain that never returns an upstream 429.

tools.name: package_metadata
tools.description: PAID $0.010000 USDC via x402. Call before adding or upgrading a dependency: package-registry metadata for one package (PyPI or npm): latest version, summary, license, dependency count; PyPI also returns 30-day downloads.

tools.name: solana_snapshot
tools.description: PAID $0.020000 USDC via x402. Call before moving funds on Solana: decision-grade account snapshot — kind; mint decimals/supply/authority; whole-account balance and recent signatures — keyless solana-public-rpc.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: u_address_check · Private data: token_snapshot · Public sink: u_sha256, u_uuid, u_base64, u_base58, u_hex, u_urlcode, u_date_diff, u_json, u_jwt, u_address_check · Destructive: u_uuid, u_address_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: u_address_check · Private data: token_snapshot · Public sink: u_sha256, u_uuid, u_base64, u_base58, u_hex, u_urlcode, u_date_diff, u_json, u_jwt, u_address_check · Destructive: u_uuid, u_address_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
